config.placement_policy: Translate one canonical true mask and its erroneous masks to each location without clipping. Reject the entire identity/area group if any translated mask leaves the image. Never silently clamp a semantic center.
config.scope: Synthetic development geometry diagnostic using existing validation identities. Eye and mouth labels locate centers only; upper_image is an image-coordinate control and need not be background. No real-occluder or identity-fidelity claim.

texture_policy: Translate the canonical texture with the mask; occluder RGB values match across locations within each identity/area group.
limits: Dataset construction report; model evaluation is recorded separately.
Center placement is not proof of complete semantic coverage.
Group rejection can bias retained cases; preserve rejection ledger.
Same development identities; not a fresh held-out evaluation.
